name: Ride909
description:
Hold the pad and tap with the kick: the nearest clock becomes step 1, and a 4-step cycle plays the off-beat 909 ride (step 3) with kick sidechain on step 1. Pitch is adjustable.
Still being fine-tuned; the official release is coming soon.

params.name: PITCH
params.detail: 909 Tune: ROM clock rate, decay tracks pitch

params.name: PUMP
params.detail: Kick sidechain amount (bottom = off, top = deep)
